sentences.text:
on 20 April, 2023
20.04.2023 Serial no.28 Aloke Crr 554 of 2020 Sanatan Das Adhikary & Ors.
Vs. The State of West Bengal & Anr.
Ms. Rita Datta ... for the State

The present revision of the year 2020 is for quashing of a proceeding in G.R. Case No. 349 of 2018 arising out of Bhagwanpur P.S. Case No. 103 of 2018 under Sections 498A/323/341 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 4 of the D.V. Act, pending before the learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Contai, Purba Medinipur.

entities.text: Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Contai, Purba Medinipur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Ms. Rita Datta, learned counsel who is present in Court is appointed on behalf of the State.
As none appears for the petitioner in spite of repeated calls since the date of listing, the revisional application stands dismissed for default.
All connected application, if any, stands disposed of.
Interim order, if any, stands vacated.
Let a copy of the order be sent to the learned trial court for compliance and to proceed with the trial in accordance with law.
Learned counsel for the State to inform the status of this case to the concerned authority.

(Shampa Dutt (Paul), J.)
